actions.action: Take 4–6 inch cuttings with 2–3 nodes and root them in water or moist soil
Trim crispy, yellow leaves and fully brown, dried stems
Slide the plant out of its pot and check the roots
If root-bound, repot one size up in fresh, well-draining potting mix
Move the plant to bright, indirect light
Check the soil and water only when the top 1–2 inches are dry

reason: The answer notes legginess and a possibly root-bound pot but splits the cause among light and watering, and it recommends cuttings and repotting while telling the owner to keep the green sections rather than cutting back 60–80%. That makes both diagnosis and advice partial, but nothing it suggests is likely to harm the plant.
